description: This file contains internal memory management utilities for container implementations in the Abseil C++ library, including aligned memory allocation, object construction, and layout compatibility checks.

classes.name: AlignedType
classes.description: A template struct for aligned types with specified alignment.

classes.name: OffsetOf
classes.description: Template struct to determine byte offsets of 'first' and 'second' in a pair-like type, avoiding non-portable offsetof on non-standard-layout types.

classes.name: IsLayoutCompatible
classes.description: Template struct to check if two types (K, V) are layout-compatible for safe union storage.

classes.name: map_slot_type
classes.description: Union representing a map slot with const and non-const pair types, allowing layout-compatible access to keys and values.

classes.name: map_slot_policy
classes.description: Policy class providing static methods for constructing, destroying, and transferring map slots.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates at least n bytes aligned to a specified power-of-two alignment using a given allocator.

methods.name: Deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory previously allocated with Allocate, using the specified allocator.

methods.name: ConstructFromTuple
methods.description: Constructs an object of type T in uninitialized storage using arguments from a tuple.

methods.name: WithConstructed
methods.description: Constructs an object of type T from a tuple and applies a function to it.

methods.name: PairArgs
methods.description: Returns a pair of tuples of references to arguments, used for piecewise construction of pairs.

methods.name: DecomposePair
methods.description: Applies a function to the decomposed pair arguments.

methods.name: SanitizerPoisonMemoryRegion
methods.description: Poisons a memory region for sanitizers.

methods.name: SanitizerUnpoisonMemoryRegion
methods.description: Unpoisons a memory region for sanitizers.
